name: Cleopatra
source:
Based on Cleopatra, who was the last active pharaoh of Ancient Egypt, only shortly survived by her son, Caesarion as pharaoh.

The prime minister of Egypt. She is incredibly obsessed with [url=/c5173]Tutankhamun[/url] and calls her Kamen-sama, Kamen-tan, etc. Although she cares deeply about her leader, her obsession is often overbearing, which usually puts Tutankhamun in slightly uncomfortable situations.

"Giza Hieroglyph!"
